integrity: The analytic comparison proves the entire n >= 128 tail. A standalone complete exact-integer certificate proves the remaining n = 4,...,127 cases, with no randomization. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the standard unweighted tube-simplex Minkowski realization of complete bipartite graph associahedra, p,q >= 2. It does not address arbitrary affine realizations, weighted tubes, noncomplete graphs, or historical priority beyond inspected sources.
title: A universal fifteen-vertex width transition for complete-bipartite graph associahedra
